text:
mei: Heads-up: found a deterministic reordering in int8 bringup for orion-nightly that affects both vertical CJK + ZWJ and mixed RTL/CJK lines. Repro on ja-vertical, zh-vertical, and a couple of ru+zh fused samples.
mei: Minimal failing example (raw chars): '明‍年1' should detok -> '明‍年1' but int8 emitted -> '1明‍年'. Also saw similar when Hebrew mark sits next to a Han char + ascii digit.
jun: can you confirm tokenizer-only detok vs generation detok?
mei: tokenizer-only (exported vocab) OK. FP16 generation matches tokenizer. Only int8 generation path misorders.
marco: do we know which kernel variant? we saw fused-attn tiling changes in commit f4d2b1a last week.
mei: ran bisect locally and on p4d: triage-bot, please bisect f4d2b1a..HEAD for int8 exports on p4d (driver 530.30).
triage-bot: bisect started, testing 10 commits on p4d with driver 530.30. Will update with first failing commit.
rachel: attach brief traces with token indices (please redact secrets). A short excerpt:
```
FP16 token idx order: [BOS, 0x660e, ZWJ, 0x5e74, DIGIT_1, EOS]
INT8 token idx order: [BOS, DIGIT_1, 0x660e, ZWJ, 0x5e74, EOS]
```
me: looks like kv write / emission index swap during fused attention step for certain unicode category sequences.
perf-bot: perf note: enabling deterministic-kv-write increases tail-latency ~3% on p4d for these workloads.
marco: bisect result?
triage-bot: bisect update: first failing commit = f4d2b1a (attention tiling + fused path rewrite). Repro only on int8 export artifacts and driver 530.30+ on our p4d cluster. Artifacts uploaded to INF-2024.
jun: immediate options: 1) runtime detok postprocess for locale-sensitive sequences (fast to ship), 2) enable deterministic emission flag in runtime (small perf hit), 3) kernel rollback / patch (longer but clean).
rachel: I prefer (2) as temporary: add per-deployment flag default off for production, enable for known sensitive customers/locales. Add tests for ja/zh vertical + mixed RTL samples.
mei: I'll open two PRs: runtime PR to add deterministic emission flag + unit tests; and a small detok-preserve patch as emergency fallback. Tagging eng-runtime and infra-kernel.
triage-bot: creating ticket INF-2024 with trace artifacts and driver/kernel metadata.
marco: filing kernel bug with infra-kernel and vendor driver team referencing f4d2b1a reproducer.
perf-bot: CI suggestion: add a nightly detok-parity job that runs the failing smoke set on int8 with deterministic-emission toggled to catch regressions and measure perf.
jun: good. Also add a small regression metric (fraction of samples with token-order mismatch) to the eval dashboard.
mei: PRs drafted: runtime #4502 (deterministic-emission toggle + tests) and runtime #4503 (detok-preserve fallback). Linking INF-2024.
triage-bot: bisect complete. Root cause = fused-attn tiling changes in f4d2b1a interacting with quantized kernel reorder on driver 530.30.
mei: leaving this thread open until kernel fix lands or runtime mitigation accepted. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
